meta.title: 7-Day Morocco Highlights Group Tour | Shared Morocco Adventures
meta.description: A 7-day shared group tour from Casablanca to Fes — Marrakech, the High Atlas, Sahara desert camp, and Chefchaouen's blue streets. From €499pp.
meta.ogDescription: A shared, fixed-date group tour covering Marrakech, the Sahara, Fes, and Chefchaouen. From €499pp.

hero.lead: Casablanca → Marrakech → Sahara Desert → Fes → Chefchaouen

overview.h2: Morocco's greatest hits, one shared loop
paras: Our signature route covers everything first-time visitors want to see — imperial cities, the High Atlas, a night in the Sahara, and the blue-washed lanes of Chefchaouen — split across a full week and shared with a small group of fellow travelers.
Because the vehicle, guide, and most accommodation are shared, this loop covers far more ground per euro than booking each leg privately.

days.label: Arrive
days.title: Casablanca to Marrakech
paras: Group pickup in Casablanca with a short stop at the Hassan II Mosque, then on to Marrakech for the evening — free time to explore Jemaa el-Fnaa.

days.label: Marrakech
days.title: Marrakech city exploration
paras: Guided walk through the medina, souks, Bahia Palace, and Majorelle Garden. Evening free to explore the food stalls of Jemaa el-Fnaa with the group.

days.label: Atlas
days.title: Marrakech to Dades Valley via the High Atlas
paras: Cross the Tizi n'Tichka pass, stop at the Ait Benhaddou kasbah, and continue through the Valley of Roses to the Dades Valley.

days.label: Desert
days.title: Dades Valley to Merzouga Sahara camp
paras: Morning at the Dades Gorge, then across the Todra Gorge (≈55 km/1 hr) to Merzouga (≈180 km/3.5 hrs). Camel trek into the Erg Chebbi dunes for a night at the shared desert camp.

days.label: Transfer
days.title: Merzouga to Fes via the Ziz Valley
paras: Sunrise over the dunes, then a scenic drive north through the Ziz Valley and Middle Atlas cedar forests, arriving in Fes by evening.

days.label: Fes
days.title: Fes medina and Chefchaouen day trip
days.lead: Optional add-on: ≈400 km round trip · about 7 hrs driving
paras: Morning guided walk through the Fes el-Bali medina and tanneries, then an optional day trip to the blue-washed streets of Chefchaouen (≈200 km/3.5 hrs each way).

days.label: Depart
days.title: Departure from Fes
paras: Free morning before your group transfer to Fes airport or train station. Trip ends.

intro: Six nights, shared throughout. Expect the same style and price bracket as these real budget properties in each location.

cards.title: Night 1 · Marrakech
html: A medina riad in the same bracket as Riad Jennah Rouge or Riad les Oliviers — dorm beds from around €15, walking distance to Jemaa el-Fnaa.

cards.title: Night 2 · Dades Gorges
html: Luxury Dades Riad or Auberge Tissadrin, half board (HB) — a kasbah-style riad with mudbrick rooms and gorge-view terraces, dinner included.

cards.title: Night 3 · Merzouga desert camp
html: Ideal Desert Camp, half board (HB) — dorm tents, shared bathrooms, dinner and breakfast included, campfire music.

cards.title: Nights 4–5 · Fes
html: A budget medina hostel comparable to Moroccan Dream Hostel or Riad Verus — traditional courtyard house, shared or twin rooms.

cards.title: Optional add-on · Chefchaouen
html: If you take the Chefchaouen day trip, it's a day visit — no extra night needed, so you stay in Fes throughout.

cards.title: Private upgrade
html: Private rooms are available on every night as a paid upgrade — let us know at booking, subject to availability.

includes: Shared transport in an air-conditioned minivan
Camel trek and 1 night at the desert camp
Guided walking tours in Marrakech and Fes
excludes: Private rooms (available on request, extra cost)

paras: Groups are capped at 16 travelers. Departures run every Sunday year-round — book early for October–April, our busiest season.
Prefer to start in Marrakech instead of Casablanca, or need a different end city? Ask us — we can often adjust the pickup/drop-off point.
Booking terms: Send an enquiry first; we confirm the departure, final price, and payment instructions by email. No payment is taken through this website.

items.q: Can I join or leave the trip partway through?
items.a: Yes, within reason — let us know at booking if you'd like to join in Marrakech instead of Casablanca, or finish elsewhere. Pricing may be adjusted accordingly.

items.q: Is the Chefchaouen day trip mandatory?
items.a: No — it's offered as an optional add-on for travelers who want to see the blue city. Those who skip it have a free day in Fes instead.
Guided city walks in Marrakech and Fes cover a few kilometers over uneven medina streets. The camel trek is a gentle, non-strenuous ride.

items.q: Is accommodation shared for all 6 nights?
items.a: Yes, the €499 price is based on shared twin/dorm rooms throughout. A private room upgrade is available on request, subject to availability.

items.q: What's the group size like on this route?
items.a: Groups typically run 8–16 travelers — a mix of solo travelers, couples, and friends, mostly in their 20s–40s.
